items.name: North Dakota Aero-Cubers 2027
items.information: #### This is a special competition that will be held inside an airplane hangar at the [Fargo Air Museum](https://fargoairmuseum.org/). Competitor registration fee includes free entrance to the museum for competitors and their guests! ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjI1MjY0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--625aad41972489424b66f71dcd86fe64ed6bff8d/ND%20Aero-Cubers%20Logo%20(small).png) This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association](https://www.midwestcubing.org/). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3RsIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--d783e6bc8ef9637fd7108a6fcfdc60829bd500da/image.png) We have local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480) and follow the [Midwest Cubing Assocation ](https://www.facebook.com/midwestcubing)for information and announcements on upcoming competitions.

items.name: River Hawks 2 Maine 2027
items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa3hrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--ae8bf56bdf7df2a9ddef232b67ef1762d8b05535/logo_200x200.png) This competition is organized by Cube New England, a non-profit organization dedicated to the growth of speedcubing in New England. * [Visit our **webpage**](https://www.cubenewengland.com) * [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.cubenewengland.com/competitions) * [Follow us on **Facebook**](https://facebook.com/cubenewengland) * [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/402975042172435) * [Join our Facebook community for **parents**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/732527678812618) * [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/3mX6xKUdRC) Students & Staff of MSAD 54 can compete in this competition free of charge. After you have registered, please use your district-issued email address to email Tommy Chestnutt @ tchestnutt@msad54.org. After confirming relationship with the district, your registration will be accepted. All other registration requirements remain the same (competiiton limits, registration timeline, etc.).

items.name: Bornholm Open 2027
items.information: Dette er den sjette konkurrence afholdt på Bornholm - deltagere i alle hastigheder er velkommen til denne konkurrence! This is the sixth competition held on Bornholm - we welcome participants of all speeds to this competition!

items.name: Twists and Turns Bloomsburg 2027
items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab. ___ This competition is made possible by partnership with the BU Players! All proceeds from this competition will be used to support their goal of keeping theatre an accessible art form on the CU-Bloomsburg campus and in the community. Learn more and find out about upcoming performances at [buplayers.org](https://linktr.ee/buplayers).
